comparison.objective: Seat a mixer bowl on locating pins, raise it and insert its retaining bolt; candidate breaks and recovers HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Heavy-part alignment onto pins followed by lift actuation and pin/bolt insertion versus fine mandrel alignment, bimanual hammering and tiny-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Bowl is seated, lift raised, bolt inserted and arms released; candidate requires four fractures, four contained tangs and no coil or shell damage.
comparison.reason: Both are multi-stage assembly tasks, but seating and latching a bowl test different abilities from controlled notch fracture and debris recovery.
